interpretation: The aggregate stop is produced after mapped_radius returns an AdaptiveSample with reliable=false. For the 624 full-cell rows this is the explicit adaptive kFull/kDegenerate guard; it is not a nested value-estimator tolerance failure. The remaining 12 rows are tiny-source/near-axis arc reliability cases whose internal guard is not currently exposed by the API.
diagnostic_limits: topology_diagnostic.tsv counts cell kinds in the topology plan; arc_reliability_diagnostic.tsv probes the remaining geometries at 128 interior radii per arc cell and is diagnostic evidence, not a replacement for instrumenting mapped_radius itself.
